Mallplaza Egana

Practical and well-connected mall for varied shopping, food and a comfortable outing if you're near Ñuñoa, La Reina or eastern Providencia.

Best for

  • Metro connection
  • Families
  • Half-day shopping

Not ideal for

  • Those looking for luxury or outlets

Getting there

Close to Plaza Egaña station.

Recommended time: 1–3 hours
